page_title: LUT 1-2 BUR | Luton v Burnley 03/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+8' Tom Lockyer (Luton) leaps highest to connect with the corner, but aims his close-range header well wide of the right post.
90+7' Alfie Doughty (Luton) will take the corner.
90+7' Luton enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
90+4' The referee is firm and issues Charlie Taylor (Burnley) a deserved yellow card.
90+3' The referee gives a yellow card to Marvelous Nakamba (Luton) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
90+3' It will be a substitution. Hannes Delcroix (Burnley) is ready to enter the pitch as Aaron Ramsey walks off.
90+2' A yellow card for bad language! Tahith Chong (Luton) couldn’t remain silent and the result is obvious.
90+2' Jay Rodriguez (Burnley) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' The ball is cleared after Aaron Ramsey (Burnley) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
87' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

85' 1 - 2 Goal! Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the top left corner. Thomas Kaminski had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:2.
84' 1 - 1 Goal! Elijah Adebayo (Luton) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Reece Burke inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:2.
80' Substitution. Lyle Foster makes way for Jay Rodriguez (Burnley).
80' Some patient build-up play from Luton as they look to unlock the defence.
78' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner but it's cleared.
77' Alfie Doughty (Luton) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
75' Lyle Foster (Burnley) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
74' Vincent Kompany has decided to make a change. Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) replaces Luca Koleosho.
74' Substitution. Zeki Amdouni did his best and is replaced by Aaron Ramsey (Burnley).
74' Lyle Foster (Burnley) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
73' Carlton Morris (Luton) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
73' Shots on target – 2:3.
70' Carlton Morris (Luton) watches the cross all the way and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort flashes narrowly wide of the left post.
69' Luton force a corner. They send men into the box.
69' The substitution has been made. Tahith Chong (Luton) has replaced Jacob Brown.
69' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Luton for a penalty. Play continues.
66' Connor Roberts (Burnley) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.

65' Reece Burke (Luton) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though the header was directed under the crossbar, James Trafford didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
64' Alfie Doughty (Luton) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
62' Substitution. Issa Kabore is replaced by Elijah Adebayo (Luton).
61' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
61' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
59' Reece Burke (Luton) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
58' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) commits a foul and Peter Bankes immediately signals a free kick.
58' James Trafford (Burnley) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
54' Sander Berge (Burnley) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
54' Some neat passing and movement from Burnley as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
51' Jacob Brown (Luton) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar.

50' Carlton Morris (Luton) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and rose high to reach a fine corner kick. He fails to direct the ball past the goalkeeper as it flies narrowly over the bar.
49' Alfie Doughty (Luton) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
48' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) works the corner short.

47' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) produced a promising shot towards the bottom left corner after his wonderful solo run, but Thomas Kaminski thwarted him with a fabulous save and the score remains the same.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Peter Bankes has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' 0 - 1 Lyle Foster (Burnley) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom right corner. Magnificent finish!
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' My Gran could have done better! Josh Brownhill (Burnley) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
44' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
43' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
42' Jacob Brown (Luton) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
38' Luca Koleosho (Burnley) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
36' Carlton Morris (Luton) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
36' Jacob Brown (Luton) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
34' Jacob Brown (Luton) reacts well to meet the lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but sends a weak header well wide of the right post.
33' Issa Kabore crosses and Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) misses a great opportunity with his head from close in, sending the ball just wide of the right post.
32' Tom Lockyer (Luton) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
30' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) nutmegs the defender on the edge of the box and lashes in a shot at goal that flies high over the bar.
29' Burnley players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
28' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker wide of the right post.
26' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
21' Today's match ends for Amari'i Bell who will be replaced by Reece Burke (Luton).
21' The resulting set piece from Burnley is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
21' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner, but his header is well saved by the keeper. Good work from Burnley as they win a corner.
21' The game is interrupted now, Amari'i Bell (Luton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
20' Burnley have been awarded a corner kick.
18' The foul by Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) was seen by Peter Bankes who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
17' CLOSE! Lyle Foster (Burnley) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the left post!
15' Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) smashes a shot at goal from the edge of the area that drifts harmlessly past the right post.
14' A crossfield pass from James Trafford (Burnley) fails to find any of his teammates.
12' One of the players from Burnley times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
11' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) takes a direct free kick.
10' Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Peter Bankes blows for a foul.
7' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
3' The Burnley players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
1' The first half has started.
Burnley will kick the game off.
Peter Bankes is introduced as the referee for today's match.
